rules: Archive record count must equal authoritative source count for the verified scope.
Archive sequence order must exactly match source order.
Roles must match source-declared roles; no role coercion.
Source records must not be merged or split.
Timestamps must be copied exactly when present; absence must remain null/absent per source mapping contract.
Every source-declared attachment must retain message association and attachment index.
System/tool records present in source must never be silently dropped.
Unknown record kinds must be preserved as opaque source-bound records or block, never discarded.
No parity mismatch may be auto-repaired.
pass_rule: Every active parity dimension passes with zero mismatches for declared source scope.
